data.name: Westin
data.gender_notes: Westin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English weast or west, meaning west. The name Westin could signify a person living in the west or a friend from the west. In the context of Christian spirituality, it could represent a spiritual journey towards the west, symbolizing a journey towards enlightenment or God. The name Westin carries the meaning “West, friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Westin usually hope their child will grow to embody west, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
